'''Lidia Istrati''' (22 June 1941 &ndash; 25 April 1997) was a writer<ref name=":0">{{cite book|year=2004|title=Dicționar biobibliografic, Scriitorii Moldovei în lectura copiilor și adolescenților|pages=215–216|location=Chișinău|publisher=Prut Internațional}}</ref> and politician from [[Moldova]]. She was born to Nicolae and Xenia and had a PhD in biology.

Lidia Istrati served as member of the [[Parliament of Moldova]] (1990 &ndash; 1997) and was the chairwoman of the [[Christian Democratic League of Women of Moldova]](1993–1997) ({{langx|ro|Liga Creștin-Democrată a Femeilor din Moldova}}).<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.vipmagazin.md/top-femei/99_Femei_ale_Moldovei/Lidia_Istrati._Sp%C4%83rg%C4%83toarea_t%C4%83cerilor_de_ghea%C5%A3%C4%83/ |title=Lidia Istrati. Spărgătoarea tăcerilor de gheaţă |access-date=2010-07-22 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20111009111030/http://www.vipmagazin.md/top-femei/99_Femei_ale_Moldovei/Lidia_Istrati._Sp%C4%83rg%C4%83toarea_t%C4%83cerilor_de_ghea%C5%A3%C4%83/ |archive-date=2011-10-09 |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref name=":0" /><ref name=":2">{{Cite book|author=Nazar Valeriu|year=2007|title=Dicționarul Scriitorilor români din Basarabia 1812-2006|page=259|location=Chișinău|publisher=Prut Internațional}}</ref>

==Biography==
She studied at the Agricultural Institute of Chișinău (currently the [[Agricultural State University of Moldova]]), which she graduated in 1962. He continues his studies, she did the doctorate at the [[Academy of Sciences of Moldova|Academy of Sciences of the Republic of Moldova]]. In 1971, she obtained her PhD in Biology. After graduating from the institute, he worked as a teacher in the village of [[Bujor, Hîncești|Bujor]], [[Hîncești district]], then editor and head of editorial office at "Ştiinţa" Publishing House, director of the Republican Literary Museum "D. Cantemir ".<ref name=":0" /><ref name=":2" />

==Activity==
She was a member of the [[Parliament of the Republic of Moldova]] in 1990–1997 (1990–1994 and 1994–1998 legislatures), on the lists of the Electoral Bloc "[[Alliance of the Christian Democratic Popular Front]]". Since 1994, she represents the Peasants and Intellectuals Bloc.<ref name=":1">{{Cite book|author=Cimpoi Mihai|year=1996|title=O istorie deschisă a literaturii române din Basarabia|page=206|location=Chișinău|publisher=ARC}}</ref>
He signed the [[Moldovan Declaration of Independence|Declaration of Independence of the Republic of Moldova]] in 1991.<ref name="jurnal" /> She was described by some colleagues as a fierce warrior against [[corruption]] and mafia.<ref name="zdg" />

==Awards==
* Lidia Istrati received the [[Order of Work Merit (Moldova)|Order of Work Glory]] from [[Mircea Snegur]] in 1996.<ref name=":0" /><ref name=":2" />
* In 2017, a commemorative plaque was installed on the facade of the house where he lived.<ref name="jurnal">{{cite web | title = Pe faţada clădirii în care a locuit Lidia Istrati, scriitoare şi semnatară a Declaraţiei de Independenţă, a fost instalată o placă memorială | publisher = jurnal.md | date = 2017-08-24 | url = http://www.jurnal.md/ro/social/2017/8/24/pe-fatada-cladirii-in-care-a-locuit-lidia-istrati-scriitoare-si-semnatara-a-declaratiei-de-independenta-a-fost-instalata-o-placa-memoriala/ | accessdate = 2017-11-03}}</ref>

==Works==
* “Tot mai departe”
* “Scara”,
* “Goană după vânt”,
* “Nevinovata inimă”

==Family==
The writer was married to agronomist Vasile Istrati. The couple had a daughter, Lucia.<ref name="vipmagazin">{{cite web | first = Viorica | last = Cucereanu | title = Lidia Istrati. Spărgătoarea tăcerilor de gheaţă | publisher = VIP Magazin | date = 2006 | url = http://arhiva.vipmagazin.md/top-femei/99_Femei_ale_Moldovei/Lidia_Istrati._Sp%C4%83rg%C4%83toarea_t%C4%83cerilor_de_ghea%C5%A3%C4%83/ | accessdate = 2017-11-03 | archive-date = 2017-11-07 | archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20171107002732/http://arhiva.vipmagazin.md/top-femei/99_Femei_ale_Moldovei/Lidia_Istrati._Sp%C4%83rg%C4%83toarea_t%C4%83cerilor_de_ghea%C5%A3%C4%83/ | url-status = dead }}</ref>  Lidia Istrati died in 1997, being slain by [[cancer]].<ref name="zdg">{{cite book | author = Tatiana Ețco | title = Femeia care ar fi putut fi preşedinte | publisher = [[Ziarul de Gardă]] | url = https://www.zdg.md/editia-print/oameni/femeia-care-ar-fi-putut-fi-presedinte | access-date = 2017-11-03}}</ref>
